title: Finish a git task: merge the branch, remove the worktree and release the claim
phrases: I'm done with this branch, merge it
close out the worktree and merge

safety.notes: Merges with a merge commit only (no rebase, squash or force), refuses on a dirty worktree, wip tip or failing test command, removes the worktree without --force and deletes the branch only with git branch -d.
